title: The Green Deepens
description: Past the heart the green stops being decoration and
starts being architecture: whole courses of the wall
gone verdigris, the gardens' colour at full strength,
and under it a sound that is not water.
The ticking is the machine vault, and the machine vault
does not care that the surface sent a map. It has been
down here counting something for longer than the hill
has had a name, and it counts in redstone.
Six stations, the same six, lit from inside.
Leave the copper where it lies. It has been doing its
